# Third-party reference: ConveyorVision-Bag-Counter

This folder is reserved for reference material from
[ConveyorVision-Bag-Counter](https://github.com/jagennath-hari/ConveyorVision-Bag-Counter)
by Jagennath Hari.

The reference project's source and demo are **not authored by Munish Vijay**.
They are provided/linked only for study and comparison under the original
BSD 3-Clause license. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the original copyright and
license notice.

The reference implementation has not been integrated into this project's
application, adapted, or validated in this repository. Its original scripts
contain machine-specific paths and older dependency APIs, so they should not
be assumed to run as-is.
